name: iot-builder
description: Build, flash and debug boards from the chat.

interface.shortDescription: Build, flash and debug boards from the chat.
interface.longDescription: Finds the board that is actually connected, identifies the chip before erasing anything, builds with the project's own toolchain, and finishes by reading back a boot log — because a flash that reports nothing is a flash nobody can verify.
defaultPrompt: Read the boot log from my ESP32

port.title: Serial port
port.description: Leave empty to detect the connected board. Set it only when several are attached and you mean a specific one.

baud.title: Flash baud rate
baud.description: Higher is faster and less forgiving on long or unshielded cables.
